record: roadmap C: protocol for the post-unblinding ARL-matched sensitivity analysis
status: POST-UNBLINDING SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS -- NOT PART OF THE PREREGISTERED RESULT
why_not_preregistered: it was motivated by the observed comparison and reuses the frozen selection and evaluation streams. It can establish that the negative L1 comparison is ROBUST to the calibration band; it cannot serve as independent confirmation. Independent confirmation would require an independently seeded repetition.
frozen_before: inspecting the extended curves and before any matched ratio was computed under this rule

disclosure.what: the FIRST pilot curve (4 grid points, no null per-replicate runs) had already been inspected before this rule was frozen, under a different rule: linear interpolation of delay against log ARL directly.
disclosure.why_it_matters: a rule chosen after seeing curves can be chosen to favour an outcome.
disclosure.mitigation: this rule was PRESCRIBED EXTERNALLY in review, not selected by me from goodness of fit, and both rules are low-flexibility and monotone. Results under BOTH rules are reported so the choice is auditable. Under the earlier rule the pilot matched ratios were 1.504 / 1.384 / 1.504 for tau_c 20/5/1.

interpolation_rule.step_1: linear interpolation of log(ARL_hat) against h, inverted to solve for the matched threshold h_matched at which sampling's null ARL equals the benchmark's ARL
interpolation_rule.step_2: linear interpolation of delay against h, evaluated at h_matched
interpolation_rule.why_this_form: low flexibility and monotone in both stages; h is the independent variable actually set by the experimenter, so both stages interpolate against it
interpolation_rule.forbidden: selecting a functional form by goodness of fit to the measured curves

bracketing_rule.requirement: every target benchmark ARL MUST be bracketed by the measured grid; no extrapolation is permitted
bracketing_rule.outward_extension: if a target lies outside the grid, EXTEND the grid by measuring additional thresholds in steps of 0.06 in h beyond the offending end, up to 3 additional points per end, until the target is bracketed
bracketing_rule.if_still_unbracketed: the cell is reported as NOT MATCHABLE. It is never extrapolated.

uncertainty.joint: inside every bootstrap draw: resample the sampling-policy NULL runs at each grid threshold, resample the BENCHMARK's null runs, and resample the paired post-change stopping times; then solve for h_matched from the resampled curve and the resampled target, and recompute the delay ratio
uncertainty.captures: uncertainty in the target ARL AND in the sampling curve, not only sampling error in the delays
uncertainty.pairing: post-change replicate indices are resampled jointly across sampling and benchmark because they share the evaluation data seed

cells_not_requiring_it: stress/tau_c=20.0/L1, stress/tau_c=1.0/L1 and stress/tau_c=1.0/L2 are directionally robust: sampling holds the SHORTER null ARL, is easier to trip, and is still slower, so the mismatch runs against the negative conclusion. They are measured anyway for uniformity.
withdrawn_permanently: the cross-policy THRESHOLD-RATIO argument is withdrawn and stays withdrawn regardless of what these matched comparisons show. Different policies have different null increment distributions, so an h ratio bounds no delay effect.
